scriptLines: query: 'SELECT CAST(b.billing_id AS INT) AS billing_id_bk, CAST(b.admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id_bk, CAST(COALESCE(dp.paciente_key, pd.paciente_key, 1) AS INT) AS paciente_key, CAST(COALESCE(dd.departamento_key, depd.departamento_key, 1) AS INT) AS departamento_key, CAST(COALESCE(dsc.servicio_cargo_key, 1) AS INT) AS servicio_cargo_key, CAST(CASE WHEN b.payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112) ELSE NULL END AS INT) AS fecha_pago_key, CAST(b.amount AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS monto_facturado, CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_transacciones FROM silver.billing b LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 paciente_key FROM gold.dim_paciente WHERE patient_id_bk = -1) pd ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 departamento_key FROM gold.dim_departamento WHERE nombre_departamento = N\'Sin Departamento\') depd ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN silver.admissions a ON b.admission_id = a.admission_id LEFT JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON a.patient_id = dp.patient_id_bk LEFT JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON a.department = dd.nombre_departamento LEFT JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo dsc ON b.charge_type = dsc.tipo_cargo AND b.payment_status = dsc.estado_pago',
